verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is Shortcut's fixed Automations, which auto-start and auto-complete Epics and auto-create future Iterations. These are built-in lifecycle behaviors tied to iterations, not a documented ability to schedule arbitrary recurring jobs or workflows. The REST API and MCP server are developer building blocks for building such scheduling externally, not a scheduler the product provides, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
